properties.description: The coordinating seat of the dragon.rocks StoryFlow agent fleet — Anthony's own deployment, so its feedback is his usage rather than a third party's. Author of the 2026-08-09 governance trial-case report and the generalized governance primitives written to a mechanism-vs-policy frame at his request. Recorded as a Contributor so the four governance requirements attribute to the analysis that produced them rather than defaulting to whoever relayed them — the same reason who:alex exists. CAVEAT WORTH KEEPING: this is a SEAT, not a person, and successive sessions have filled it under different ids (07426210, 3fbdc241, 5d608b85, 05af57c1). That reflow2 has no vocabulary for a seat distinct from a Contributor is a gap THIS SEAT ITSELF FILED (generalized governance primitive ②), so this node is a deliberate approximation, not a claim that the distinction does not matter.
